name_zh: ASUS DaaS 企業電腦租賃
summary_zh: 企業透過租賃合約，以固定月費取得 ASUS 商用設備與維護支援，免去一次性大筆採購，設備汰換也更有彈性。
summary_en: Businesses lease ASUS commercial devices with maintenance support for a fixed monthly fee, avoiding large upfront purchases and gaining flexibility in refresh cycles.

features.zh: 降低一次性購置電腦的成本
把採購支出轉為固定月租
features.en: Turns hardware spend into a fixed monthly fee

features.zh: 租賃專案可依需求彈性客製
提供維護服務，減輕管理負擔
features.en: Maintenance included to reduce management burden

features.zh: 涵蓋完整的設備生命週期管理

audience_zh: 各產業想降低設備採購門檻、以月費管理電腦的企業
audience_en: Businesses in any industry that want to avoid upfront hardware costs and manage PCs on a monthly fee

prices.plan_zh: 商用筆電租賃方案（標準辦公型，36 期）
商用桌機租賃方案（固定工位型，36 期）
商用顯示器租賃方案（辦公擴充型，36 期）

name_zh: AIS 智慧排程派工系統
summary_zh: 為智慧工廠設計，串接 ERP、MES、設備與現場報工資料，即時掌握工單、產能、物料、人力與設備狀態，由 AI 自動排出最佳派工計畫。
summary_en: Built for smart factories: connects ERP, MES, equipment and shop-floor reporting to track orders, capacity, materials, staff and machines in real time, then uses AI to generate optimized dispatch plans.

features.zh: AI 排程與派工最佳化
與 ERP、MES 系統整合
即時滾動重排程
甘特圖視覺化管理

audience_zh: 導入智慧工廠的製造業者

name_zh: Zynkr AI 業務管理與自動跟進
summary_zh: 以 AI 將聯絡人、公司與交易集中到同一工作區，提供名片自動建檔、客戶背景調查、交易提醒與自動擬稿，支援繁中與英文。
summary_en: An AI workspace for contacts, companies and deals, with business-card capture, client background research, deal reminders and auto-drafted follow-ups, in Traditional Chinese and English.

features.zh: AI 一鍵查清客戶背景
features.en: AI researches a client's background in one click

features.zh: 提醒每次該做的跟進，不漏接
features.en: Reminders so no follow-up is missed

features.zh: 一分鐘內擬好跟進信
features.en: Follow-up emails drafted in about a minute

features.zh: 名片拍照即可建檔
features.en: Snap a business card to add a contact

name_zh: 閃電下單 全通路接單
summary_zh: 給中小型餐飲店的輕量接單方案，整合各點餐通路，只需出單印表機加手機 App 就能管理訂單，並支援顧客線上多元支付。
summary_en: A lightweight ordering solution for small food businesses: all ordering channels in one place, run from a phone app and a receipt printer, with online payments for customers.

features.zh: 不用 POS 機，手機加連網印表機即可營業
features.en: No POS terminal needed — a phone and a networked printer are enough

features.zh: 顧客掃 QR Code 自助點餐
features.en: Customers self-order by scanning a QR code

features.zh: 內用、外帶、自取與外送訂單集中管理
features.en: Dine-in, takeaway, pickup and delivery orders in one place

features.zh: 串接 LINE 的會員集點

audience_zh: 快餐店、夜市小吃、市集攤位、餐車、飲料甜點店
audience_en: Quick-service restaurants, night-market stalls, food trucks, drink and dessert shops

summary_zh: 把請假、採購、費用申請與內部審核搬到線上，每張表單都有紀錄、簽核進度隨時可追蹤。
summary_en: Moves leave requests, purchasing, expense claims and internal reviews online, so every form is recorded and every approval step is trackable.

features.zh: 紙本表單轉為線上表單
依部門與職級自動跑簽核流程
features.en: Approval routing by department and job level

features.zh: 簽核紀錄完整保存可查詢
手機也能隨時簽核

audience_zh: 需要電子簽核的小型團隊到成長型企業
audience_en: Small teams to growing companies that need e-approvals

summary_zh: 雲端一站式管理平台，不只是收銀，更協助品牌複製成功模式、管理加盟並深耕顧客關係。
summary_en: A cloud all-in-one platform that goes beyond checkout: replicate what works across stores, manage franchises and deepen customer relationships.

features.zh: 連鎖門市管理
總部加盟管理
會員與行銷整合

audience_zh: 經營連鎖或加盟體系的餐飲品牌
audience_en: Food brands running chain or franchise operations

summary_zh: 整合貼文、圖文、文案、SEO 與合規五組 AI 引擎，一鍵產出商品介紹與社群文案，並含訂單、庫存與會員管理。
summary_en: Five AI engines for posts, images, copy, SEO and compliance generate product and social copy in one click, plus order, inventory and member management.

features.zh: AI 產生行銷文案
協助製作圖文素材
SEO 內容優化
內容合規檢查

audience_zh: 想經營網路商店與自動化行銷的品牌
audience_en: Brands running online stores that want automated marketing

summary_zh: 針對人才斷層、新舊混牌設備、資安與救火式管理等痛點，以設備全面串接、地端資料處理與 AI 異常偵測改善。
summary_en: Addresses talent gaps, mixed legacy equipment, security and firefighting-style management with full equipment connectivity, on-premises data and AI anomaly detection.

features.zh: 以高資安規格整合跨廠設備
features.en: Connects equipment across sites to high security standards

features.zh: 無紙化即時報工
主動偵測設備異常
資料於地端處理

audience_zh: 面臨人才斷層與新舊設備整合的製造業者
audience_en: Manufacturers facing talent gaps and mixed legacy equipment
